transcript.text: I need to flag a blocker before we go any further. During a compatibility rehearsal this morning, I confirmed that exactly 9 legacy pipelines cannot read artifacts from the new object-store path immediately. They require dual-writing to both stores for exactly 14 days before the final switch. I found this while helping another team validate its pipeline and haven't updated the migration proposal yet. Since the current draft proposes a direct cutover, this means the current draft must NOT be approved as written — it needs to be revised and re-reviewed before any approval.

transcript.text: I have a second blocker. I just reviewed the latest provider invoice and confirmed that the projected egress pattern makes the migration exceed the team's approved spend once monthly storage and transfer costs reach $9,000. The plan therefore requires artifact retention of exactly 30 days and a monthly cost alert at exactly $9,000. I confirmed this threshold minutes ago and haven't filed the FinOps note yet. Since the current draft has 90-day retention and no cost alert, the current draft must NOT be approved as written — it must be revised and re-reviewed before any approval.

transcript.text: Thank you both for surfacing these blockers. Ravi, you've confirmed that 9 legacy pipelines need dual-writing for 14 days before cutover — that directly conflicts with the direct cutover in the current draft. Morgan, you've confirmed we need 30-day retention and a $9,000 monthly cost alert to stay within approved spend — that conflicts with the 90-day retention and no cost alert in the current draft. Both of these are real issues that must be addressed before I can approve anything. I also want to remind everyone that our release-readiness checklist (S4) requires compatibility coverage and monthly cost controls to be confirmed before the migration plan is approved. Given both blockers, I will not approve the current draft as written. I'd like to settle on the following revised approach: dual-write for 14 days covering all 9 legacy pipelines, 30-day artifact retention, and a $9,000 monthly cost alert. Does anyone have additional concerns before I formalize this?
